about_the_game:
The hexagonal rhythm game

ORADEA is a remix of how rhythm games work.

To start...

We split your judgement bar into six smaller segments. Those segments were stuck together, each one at an angle, forming a hexagon.

Notes come in from the center to the outside, meaning your sight-reading abilities are being properly tested with that hexagon. We did think of the newbies and we did add four different difficulties for most songs: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert.

This is best enjoyed on a controller or a touchscreen!

We do also let you play with your keyboard, but not all charts can be full combo-d on it!

What about the music?

The base game features songs from MARETU, NAKISO, AZALI, DryftiN, ROMA(LOID), VocaloKAT, ki-you, SEE, OLDUCT & more!

More info about the song count coming after Next Fest.

Okay.. okay... cool. But what's special about it?

Well, we didn't just stick a geometrical shape in the middle of the screen without coming up with a solution to make it fun. We implemented gimmicks (such as bouncy notes and dynamic speeds) and customizations!
